header.title: Search the sanctions list
header.lede: Type a name. It is checked against the public sanctions lists named below, right here in your browser — nothing you type ever leaves your device.

search.placeholder: Search a name, e.g. Ivan Fakovich

scope.allUnknown: Searching every list in the signed catalog.
scope.usOnly: Searching US OFAC only on this device, to save memory.
scope.streamingNote: Each search takes a few seconds on this device, because the lists are checked one at a time to save memory.

list.ageUnknown: {{list}} · Age unknown — this list cannot say when it was last refreshed

strictness.caption: Strictness
strictness.hint: how closely a name must match

boot.firstRunNote: First visit only — up to about 80 MB. Once it's here, screening runs in this tab and nothing you type leaves the device.
boot.loadingModel: Loading the name-matching model (~23 MB, once)…

results.browsing: Browsing all {{total}} entries on the lists — searched entirely in your browser.
results.searchError: Screening failed — this name was NOT cleared. {{detail}}. Edit the name to try again.
results.noMatch: No sanctions match “{{query}}”. Screened in {{ms}} ms.
results.matchCount: {{n}} potential match{{suffix}} — screened in {{ms}} ms, in your browser.
results.noPrimaryMatch: No match above the {{level}} threshold for “{{query}}”. Screened in {{ms}} ms.
results.capped: Showing the {{n}} closest matches — there may be more below the cut-off. Add a surname or middle name to narrow it.

foundVia.phoneticOnly: This name was found only because it sounds similar. Sound never adds to the score — the score above still decides.

status.unavailable: Score proof can't be checked here
status.invalid: Score altered — don't rely on it

explain.weak: Weak match — check it by hand
